subject: general
question: Average of first 'N' even natural numbers is 55. What is the value of 'N'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of the first N even natural numbers is always (N + 1).

Given: Average = 55

⇒ N + 1 = 55

⇒ N = 55 − 1 = 54

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of first N even natural numbers = 55

**Formula Used:**

Sum of first N even numbers = N(N + 1)

Average = Sum ÷ N = [N(N + 1)] ÷ N = N + 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98755fa766b2f0b61b9f869c52aa7a47dd7d02127ff865a57047d383c880872e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First N even natural numbers: 2, 4, 6, ..., 2N

⇒ This is an Arithmetic Progression (AP) with first term (a) = 2 and last term (l) = 2N.

⇒ Average of an AP = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2

⇒ 55 = (2 + 2N) ÷ 2

⇒ 55 = 1 + N

⇒ N = 55 − 1

⇒ N = 54

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of First N Natural Numbers

The average of the first N natural numbers (1, 2, 3, ..., N) is given by (N + 1) ÷ 2.

Average of First N Odd Numbers

The average of the first N odd natural numbers (1, 3, 5, ..., 2N − 1) is always equal to N.

Sum of First N Natural Numbers

The sum of the first N natural numbers is calculated using the formula [N × (N + 1)] ÷ 2.
